what_this_measures: G_FP3: the pipeline runs end to end under each foot-point rule, and what pose costs.
note: Both arms completed without a crash, which is half of G_FP3. The runtime half fails: pose runs once per DETECTION (121.15 detections/frame across 7 cameras), not once per frame, so its cost scales with crowd size. 2.52x the wall clock, i.e. 39.7% of the baseline rate against a 80% floor.
